description: This file defines utility functions and constants for integrating Spark with Hadoop YARN, including environment variable handling, resource management, and security configurations.

methods.name: addPathToEnvironment
methods.description: Adds or appends a path variable to the environment map.

methods.name: replaceEnvVars
methods.description: Replaces environment variable references in a string with their actual values, supporting Unix, Windows, and OS-agnostic syntax.

methods.name: addOutOfMemoryErrorArgument
methods.description: Adds JVM argument to handle OutOfMemoryError by killing the process, with platform-specific commands.

methods.name: escapeForShell
methods.description: Escapes a command-line argument for execution in Yarn's shell environment, handling Unix and Windows specifics.

methods.name: getApplicationAclsForYarn
methods.description: Generates a map of application access control lists for YARN based on SecurityManager settings.

methods.name: getContainerId
methods.description: Retrieves the current container ID from environment variables.

methods.name: executorOffHeapMemorySizeAsMb
methods.description: Calculates off-heap memory size for executors based on Spark configuration and resource request.
